children: First Citizens completed acquisition of 138 BMO branches, assuming approximately $5 billion in deposits and $650 million in loans.
Completed conversion of 138 branches acquired from BMO Bank N.A., expanding presence across Midwest, Great Plains and West.
Assumed about $5 billion in deposits and $650 million in loans, increasing scale and client relationships.
Now operates more than 600 branches nationwide and holds over $225 billion in assets as a top 20 U.S. bank.
Announced regional leadership appointments to support expanded footprint and relationship-first strategy.
Committed approximately $1 million in community investments across existing and new markets during 2026–2027.
